_comment: ATS job boards polled daily. slug = the board id in the ATS URL. Unknown or wrong slugs return 404 and are skipped silently; add and remove freely. Find a company's ATS by opening its careers page and looking for boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug> or apply.workable.com/<slug>.
